Boxes respawn when player leaves their row range - can't collect permanently one-by-one. Player at row 28-31, col 21-23. Trail at col 20. Remaining boxes: top-right (24-27, 44-47) and bottom (36-39, 32-35). Bar at 28-31, 28-39.
Open question: How to collect all boxes if they respawn? Maybe need to collect them simultaneously or in a specific pattern. Or maybe the goal involves the bar.
Plan: Try moving RIGHT to approach the bar and see if interacting with it helps. Also try RIGHT to approach the bottom box.
